decisions: The filed hypothesis (callee arity not applied at this call site) is WRONG and the round-12 refuter already said so; arity inference succeeds, the callee alone recovers four parameters. Confirmed by instrumenting the trial machinery: at 0x11477 the RSI and RDI trials come back active=false nouse=false, i.e. realism passed and ancestor_op_use/only_op_use returned false.

The refuter's redirect (caller-side trial activation, only_op_use) is RIGHT, and the exact gate is check_call_double_use. Dumping the only_op_use descendant walk names the rejecting op: CPUI_CALL @0x11430, reached from the 0x1146f value through INDIRECT@0x11477 -> MULTIEQUAL@0x1141b -> SUBPIECE@0x11422 -> INT_XOR@0x11422 -> PIECE/ZEXT -> the call. The competing use is the next iteration's `xor edi,edi`.
INT_XOR(v,v) is 0 regardless of v, so that descendant carries nothing and the rejection is unearned. The fix skips such an op in the walk rather than tuning any scoring rule.

Sameness is structural, not Varnode identity: at ActionActiveParam the two `esi` reads are two distinct SUBPIECE Varnodes (CSE has not run), which is exactly why the constant fold has not fired and the idiom is still live dataflow. A depth-2 walk over COPY/SUBPIECE/PIECE/INT_ZEXT/INT_SEXT is what the shape needs.
INT_AND and INT_OR are deliberately not in the set: `v & v` is `v`, so those uses really do observe the value.
Default-ON is required by the acceptance probe, which passes no --option, and is earned: 0/675 datatests and a sweep whose direction is 148 recovered argument positions against 6 given up.

The 6 given-up positions are not a defect of this change. Making a trial active at call A is exactly what upstream's check_call_double_use consults when scoring call B, so a value two calls share can be exclusively a parameter of only one. Both losing hunks are +/-0 lines and the value stays live at its other use.
